cases.explain: The comparative construction 'выше' (higher/above) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He was faithful to the service entrusted to him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb поручить (entrust) with accusative of the thing entrusted governs accusative case.

cases.sentence: строителю дома оказывается больше чести, чем самому ___.
cases.translation: The builder of the house is given more honor than the house itself.
cases.explain: The preposition 'чем' with comparative structures uses dative case for the compared object.

cases.translation: Every house has its own builder.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/at the place of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Моисей был верным служителем во всем ___ Божьем.
cases.translation: Moses was a faithful servant in all of God's house.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Дом Его — мы, если сохраним до конца смелость и ___.
cases.translation: His house is us, if we hold fast boldness and hope to the end.
cases.explain: The transitive verb сохранить (keep/hold) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: если услышите Его ___, то не ожесточайте ваших сердец.
cases.translation: If you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.
cases.explain: The transitive verb услышать (hear) with a direct object governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: берегитесь, чтобы ни у кого из вас ___ не стало злым и неверным.
cases.translation: Take care that no one among you has an evil and unbelieving heart.
cases.explain: The transitive verb стать (become) with an object in accusative case requires the accusative form of the noun.

reading.question: Who is presented as higher in authority than Moses?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Иисус выше Моисея' (Jesus is above Moses).

reading.ru: Он был верен поручившему ему служение так же, как и Моисей был верен во всем Доме Божьем.
reading.question: In what way were both Jesus and Moses alike?
options: Both were faithful in their respective duties
Both led the people out of Egypt
reading.correct: Both were faithful in their respective duties
reading.explain: The passage compares their faithfulness: both were faithful in what was entrusted to them.

reading.ru: Мы стали сотоварищами Христа, если только мы до конца сохраним нашу твердую веру, которую мы имели вначале.
reading.question: On what condition do we become partakers of Christ?
options: If we keep our firm faith to the end
reading.correct: If we keep our firm faith to the end
reading.explain: The text states we become partakers of Christ 'if only we do hold firm the assurance and the glorying of the hope firm to the end.'

reading.ru: Поэтому я поклялся в гневе моем, они не войдут в мой покой.
reading.question: What did God swear in His wrath?
options: That they would not enter His rest
That they would have many children
reading.correct: That they would not enter His rest
reading.explain: God swore 'They will not enter into my rest' as a statement of judgment.

reading.question: What is the text asking about when it mentions 'these rebels'?
options: Those who rebelled against God in the wilderness
Those who built the tower of Babel
reading.correct: Those who rebelled against God in the wilderness
reading.explain: The context indicates these were the generation that came out of Egypt under Moses and rebelled.

reading.ru: Не все ли те, кто вышел из Египта под руководством Моисея?
reading.question: Who is being referred to as the rebels?
options: Those who came out of Egypt under Moses
reading.correct: Those who came out of Egypt under Moses
reading.explain: The rhetorical question clarifies that the rebels were those who were led out of Egypt by Moses.
